params.body: Builds on the design system pull request (merge that first: this one reads the `ink` and `primary` tokens it adds, and the two derived images of the mark). The only public page of Naviskore, redone on the new tokens. Left: the mark as a surface, not a picture in a corner. The panel runs from the red side of what athena and xplora share to the blue side, at chroma 0.008 to 0.016, which is fifteen to thirty times weaker than either group's own colours; the compass sits large and faint bottom right, cut off before the wordmark. Right: the choice, and nothing else. What changed against the previous version of this page: - No tagline, no top bar, no card frame around Microsoft's lockup (it draws its own; a border around it put a box in a box). - The mark is `naviskore-inkt.png` as a mask in `ink-900`, not pure black, which was hard on a light ground. On a phone the panel is a short band and the big compass is hidden, because it would sit behind the wordmark. - Each school row carries the school's own mark (`athena-beeldmerk.png`, the 300px icon from athena-school.be). With one school group it repeats; with a second it starts to distinguish. The rows hover to `primary`. - The footer reads "Lukt aanmelden niet? Neem contact op met de beheerder van je school." instead of a sentence that read like an instruction to a machine. - The password form (off the SSO hosts only) got real labels, autocomplete attributes and a full-width `primary` button. `LoginPageTest::the_logo_carries_alt_text` became `the_logo_carries_an_accessible_name`: the mark is a `role="img"` box with an `aria-label`, not an ``, so the promise is the same and the markup moved. The other login assertions (one h1, canonical, og tags, robots, sitemap, the SSO host offering only the providers) are untouched and green. Rendered and looked at, desktop and 390px, against the built stylesheet. ## Checks - `php artisan test`: 196 passed, 1 failed (`BuildStampTest`, worktree only). - `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed. `npm run build`: fine.
params.title: De inlogpagina op het design system
